name: Checkr
description: Monitor Checkr background check candidates for HR verification compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Checkr at https://dashboard.checkr.com
2. Go to Account Settings > Developer Settings > API keys
3. Copy your API key
4. Enter it below

Note: Both production and staging API keys are supported. The integration automatically detects your key's environment and routes to the correct Checkr API, so no extra configuration is needed. Production and staging keys are separate — use the key for the environment you want to audit.
